646

Called Meeting of City Council
Austin Texas April 14, 1879.
Mayor De Grosa Presiding.
Roll Called. Present Aldermen Crow,
Croaker, Platt, Farnes, Strong & Bingham. 6 Absent Aldermen Millet, Hertz, Nathe and
Sheehan
Quorum Present.
The following business was transacted.
Petition of Property holders of Block No 111 to close up the alley in said Block for 4
days, said alley to be used as a dining hall for the Saengerfest, together with the
following resolution.
Resolved that the petition of the above
named citizens be granted.
Resolution adopted and petition granted.
Petition of Gillewyn to erect a stand pipe on West Pecan Street near Cooks corner together
with the following report of the Street committee. We recommend privilege as requested
without expense to the city, also the City Marshal and Mr. Erwin may
agree upon its location.
G. Gross
N. M. Strong.
Report adopted and petition granted.
Alderman Farnes moved that no Alder-
men shall receive pay for this meeting.
Motion carried.
On motion the Council adjourned.
-Approved
May 7, 1879 L. M. Bradley
City Clerk.
